Introduction
This document outlines the high pressure 
feed water pump inspection steps I1, which must be carried out every 6 months as 
indicated by M6 in the title block 
The pump technical data:
 Type: centrifugal pump multistage 
 R.P.M 
: 2980 
 No of stage : (1+8) Power : 789 K W

h

bar
The first draft initiated by eng. Mohamed 
Taha El Mansy , tested by eng. Abdel Qader Fath Alla at 26 Feb 2003 
on Module 1 pump no. A and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir 
Abdel Gilel, accepted by general director eng. Sobhy Mohamed El Bakry 
and approved by eng. Moneer Mohamed El Wakeel Head Sector 
of Demietta PS.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Shut down the pump
Disconnect the power supply 
& rack out the C.B
Isolate the inlet & outlet 
valves for circulation circuit of mechanical seal.
Put red tag on the pump.
The safety deppartment. must check 
the isolation and surrounding the work zone.
Tools and Equipment
Grease gun Type of grease (aluminum complex grease)
Complete maintenance tool set,
 Cleaning fluid
Buchlite for ELEC. isolating & alignment devices
Buchlite for ELEC. isolating & alignment devices
Work to be Carried Out
Check the coupling {tooth flanges for cracking O rings for oil leakage 
 sealing faces} replace the damaged one.
Change the grease in the coupling by new grease. (0.5 kg of aluminum complex grease)
Clean the filter of circulation circuit for mechanical seal
Align the coupling hubs and check the axial move ability of casings 
 intermediate sleeves
Change oil as chemical analysis every year.
